source_resources.selection_rationale: Normative reference for unittest.TestCase, assertEqual, assertRaises, and python -m unittest output.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Online Python documentation may be unavailable without internet access.
source_resources.safe_fallback: unittest ships with the interpreter, so every example runs offline; help(unittest.TestCase) documents the assert methods.
